description: Vencertia v1.0 synthetic L0 regression cases

cases.description: Strong problem & wtp evidence -> GO commit
Fatal negative evidence -> KILL
Insufficient wtp evidence -> ABSTAIN + paid pilot
Premise failed but value transferable -> PIVOT
Uncertain timing -> HOLD
Channel selection -> SELECT_OPTION
Conditional on runway -> CONDITIONAL_GO
Company-case evidence without transferability does not move project belief
REAL_PAYMENT moves belief to exact posterior (reference probability)
NEUTRAL evidence adds 0.15 mass per side (probability stays ~0.5)
Conflict between payment and refund keeps system honest (ABSTAIN ok)
Cheap research targets critical -> RESEARCH_MORE
Cheap research exhausted -> EXPERIMENT_REQUIRED
No research and no experiment -> SEARCH_EXHAUSTED
Resolved GO -> EXECUTE convergence
Critical uncertainty low + conditional -> CONDITIONALLY_CONVERGED
Critical WTP -> paid pilot outranks interviews
Time penalty: fast experiment outranks slow one (same cost)
Cost penalty: cheap experiment outranks expensive one
WTP has highest decision impact -> critical = wtp
REAL_PAYMENT dominates MODEL_PRIOR (regression)
Correlated evidence is discounted (dedup)
ABSTAIN contract: next experiment must be proposed
Relaxed critical-uncertainty threshold -> GO
Fatal evidence with relaxed threshold -> KILL
Eligible company case updates project prior (prior-only, no pseudo-count)
